info.title: Supergood Solutions public API
info.summary: Public reads of the rate card and service list, and the fit-check POST.
info.description:
Two GET documents are static files on https://supergood.solutions. The fit check is POST https://supergood-intake.vercel.app/api/intake. No API key, bearer token, or account is required. See https://supergood.solutions/auth.md.

Version 1.0.0 is the current contract. pricing.json and services.json are the full list in one response and are not paged. A breaking change keeps the old path and adds a new one. This host cannot send a Sunset or Deprecation header (GitHub Pages). The developers page records the change: https://supergood.solutions/developers/.

The intake POST is not idempotent. A retry can email Ryan twice. There is no Idempotency-Key support. Each IP gets 10 requests per 10 minutes. The same fit check is also available as the submit_fit_check tool on the MCP server at https://supergood-intake.vercel.app/api/mcp (card: https://supergood.solutions/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

servers.description: Fit-check function. Separate project from this static site.

post.description: Emails the inquiry to Ryan Sandoval. Send one request per person. A repeat POST sends another email. No auth. Browser requests are allowed from https://supergood.solutions only; another Origin gets 403. Callers with no Origin header are fine. The form at /start/ will not submit until 3 seconds after the first field focus. The function drops a body whose elapsedMs is under 3000 or whose company field is filled, answers 200 {ok:true}, and sends no email. Leave company as an empty string. Put the employer in companyName.

post.description: Emails the inquiry to Ryan Sandoval. Send one request per person. A repeat POST sends another email. No auth. Browser pages on https://supergood.solutions receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin for this URL. The form at /start/ will not submit until 3 seconds after the first field focus. On 2026-10-29 the function returned 200 for elapsedMs of 1, so do not treat elapsedMs as a server-side lock. Leave company as an empty string. Put the employer in companyName.

example.name: Ada Lovelace
example.handoff: A Monday report rebuilt by hand from three spreadsheets.

200.description: The inquiry was accepted. Ryan reads it and replies.

400.description: The body was rejected. error is json when the body is not a JSON object, required when name, email, or handoff is missing, email when the address is not valid, and paysForTools when the value is not Yes, Not sure, or No. Read hint, fix the body, and send once.

value.message: Name, email and handoff are required.
value.hint: Include non-empty "name", "email" and "handoff" (the work you want handed off).

value.message: The email address does not look valid.

403.description: A browser request from an origin other than supergood.solutions. Call from a server, or use the form at /start/.

example.message: Browser requests from this origin are not allowed.
example.hint: Submit from https://supergood.solutions/start/, or call the API from a server (no Origin header).

429.description: More than 10 requests from one IP in 10 minutes. A Retry-After header gives the seconds to wait.

example.message: Too many requests from this address.
example.hint: Wait a minute and try again. Real submissions are rarely sent more than a few times an hour.

405.description: The method was not POST. Send POST with Content-Type application/json. A GET to this URL returns this error.

example.hint: Send a POST request with a JSON body.

500.description: The endpoint is not configured. Try again later.

502.description: The email could not be delivered. Try again in a minute.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the numeric prices.

updated.description: Calendar date the document was last edited, YYYY-MM-DD.

price.description: Fixed price in currency. Present when the offer has a single price.

priceFrom.description: Lowest published price in currency. The quoted price can be higher.

email.description: Work email Ryan should reply to.

handoff.description: The manual work they want off the team's plate, in their words.

paysForTools.description: Are you OK paying for the software and tools your workflows run on, on your own accounts? The form and the MCP tool require it. The endpoint accepts a request without it.

company.description: Honeypot. Send an empty string. The employer name goes in companyName.

enum: Running, but we don't trust it
currentState.description: Where the work sits today. Optional. Empty string if unknown.

teamSize.description: How many people touch the work. Optional.

timeline.description: When they want to move. Optional.

source.description: Where the request came from. The form sends supergood.solutions/start. The in-page tool sends supergood.solutions/webmcp.

elapsedMs.description: Milliseconds since the person started the form. The function drops a value under 3000: it answers 200 and sends no email.

FitCheckError.description: Every error from the intake function. error is a stable code, message says what went wrong, hint says how to fix it.
